blurb: Range slider with elastic bounce animation on release.
description: Dual-thumb slider that animates each thumb with a spring-like bounce when values are set. Built with React and Tailwind.
use_when: A range selection that should feel responsive and tactile.
avoid_when: When animation might distract from precision input.
a11y: Keyboard arrow keys to adjust values. No explicit prefers-reduced-motion guard mentioned.
